Implemented and committed task snapshots on branch `feature/task-snapshots` in commit `09ac7c3`.

Verification: imports and Ruff checks passed, as did focused snapshot and web endpoint checks. The full test suite had **7 passes and 1 failure**: `test_monitor_with_console` failed because the console connection closed with `OSError: [Errno 107] Transport endpoint is not connected`; it also failed when rerun alone. No baseline comparison was performed, so the cause remains unconfirmed.
